stations.title: Studio API
stations.text: Answers each day, in any order.

captions: Kofi wants the day buttons to work, so people can see just Thursday.
Tap Tuesday, then Thursday, and Tuesday's late answer takes over the screen.
You ask for the chosen day, let the last choice win, and cancel the rest.
Now Thursday shows Thursday, however late Tuesday's answer comes.
Every tap gets its own list, and an answer nobody wants never reaches the screen.
